findings.title: Non-Pages devnet RPC proxy always returns HTTP 200

status.pages_proxy: Separate PagesNetwork path preserves status and has an explicit source-level acceptance test.

findings.detail: The generic devnet post helper resolves only response-body text and discards the upstream HTTP status. DevnetNetwork.forward then fulfills every completed upstream response with status 200. A non-2xx response therefore reaches the application with a different transport status in this harness. PagesNetwork carries status and body and has a test asserting propagation of an upstream failure status.
findings.impact: The generic devnet journeys cannot establish HTTP-status handling fidelity for the deployed application. This is a test-harness defect, not evidence that the application mishandles production HTTP errors.
findings.recommendation: Use a shared status-preserving response representation for both devnet proxy helpers and retain a focused transport-fidelity assertion.
findings.validation: Static source inspection only. No harness, test, server, RPC request or transaction was executed.

quality_gaps.title: Pages qualification explicitly excludes a successful real-chain ERC-20 payment path
quality_gaps.detail: The Pages c2 test expressly asserts that the local deployment tokens are absent from the compiled token choices and the allowlisted token addresses have no code on that chain. Its real-chain checkout journey uses the native asset. Separate ERC-20 scan/sweep tests rely on authored RPC fixtures.
quality_gaps.impact: A successful Pages/devnet run of these tests would provide native-asset journey evidence; it would not qualify successful ERC-20 checkout, approval/permit, or real token-transfer behavior through the same browser artifact.
quality_gaps.recommendation: Track native and ERC-20 qualification separately, and add independently reviewable local real-chain ERC-20 acceptance evidence using a fixture deployment aligned with the compiled token configuration. No execution was performed in this review.

quality_gaps.title: Export leak guard samples persistent storage at the end of the journey

status.main: stealth-export suite absent at pinned main

quality_gaps.detail: recordLeaks records request/console/error/download events as they occur, but its URL/history/storage/IndexedDB/cache inspection is performed by snapshot(). The secret-leak scenario calls that snapshot once after completing multiple export and recovery actions.
quality_gaps.impact: The assertions establish absence of the selected synthetic secret markers at that sampled state. They do not establish that no transient plaintext storage write occurred and was removed earlier. No transient write or application leakage was established by this source review.
quality_gaps.recommendation: If continuous absence is part of the intended acceptance claim, observe sensitive storage writes using synthetic fixture markers or add checks at the individual credential/export transitions. Keep the reported evidence limited to the channels and moments actually inspected.

historical_observations.title: Older network-authorization fixture uses quantity-shaped balance results
historical_observations.detail: The older network-authorization test supplied short quantity-style results for ERC-20 balanceOf calls. The newer 19055300 variant uses encodeAbiParameters for both the stale and replacement balance results and documents the distinction from eth_chainId. This is not a current candidate defect.
historical_observations.validation: Both complete diffs in the variant chain were inspected; no test was run.

Assertions are unexecuted.

Source observes dispatched HTTP(S) browser requests and includes persisted-policy refusal, cancellation, renewed grant replacement, second-tab endpoint changes, explicit balance-read consent and own-node refusal.

Source separates selected named pins from other named/legacy pins, invalidates stale confirmation across tabs, exercises offline verification and passphrase-policy recheck, and removes trusted review after idle lock.

Source checks credential gates, exact saved-file recovery, secret marker absence in observed channels, discarded in-flight exports after lock/wipe, durable pre-broadcast journal state and duplicate-sweep refusal through reload.

The flows suite already contains a late-wallet-hash and explicit confirmed-clear scenario. It was read and was not reported as missing coverage. Predecessor-owned BROWSER-01, PN-01 through PN-05 and SN-K01 were not duplicated.
